instruction: I placed an order for lunch meeting with some of my coworkers in office today. I had sent out an email yesterday to them asking for individual orders, and everyone involved responded with their chosen food item and its base price. The tip was was 20% on the food cost, and delivery fee was $11. Unlike individual orders, the tip and delivery fee are to be equally shared among all, including me. Make all the necessary (public) venmo requests with a description note, "For Lunch Meeting".

import re
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP

lindsey_email='lindseysimpson@gmail.com'
thread=apis.gmail.show_thread(email_thread_id=47820, access_token=gmail_token)

# Extract food orders from emails sent by coworkers (excluding Lindsey's own message)
orders=[]
for e in thread['emails']:
    sender=e['sender']['email']
    if sender.lower()==lindsey_email.lower():
        continue
    body=e['body']
    m=re.search(r'\$\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?)', body)
    amount=Decimal(m.group(1)) if m else None
    orders.append({
        'from_email': sender,
        'email_id': e['email_id'],
        'amount': amount,
        'raw_body': body
    })

print('orders_extracted_count', len(orders))
for o in orders:
    print('from', o['from_email'], 'amount', o['amount'])

# Validate all amounts found
print('missing_amounts', [o['from_email'] for o in orders if o['amount'] is None])

from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP

# Inputs from extracted email replies
orders = [
    {'from_email':'as_moore@gmail.com','amount':Decimal('19')},
    {'from_email':'corwils@gmail.com','amount':Decimal('28')},
    {'from_email':'cheweber@gmail.com','amount':Decimal('19')},
    {'from_email':'morgan-harrison@gmail.com','amount':Decimal('29')},
    {'from_email':'ta.weav@gmail.com','amount':Decimal('22')},
    {'from_email':'alexwhite@gmail.com','amount':Decimal('25')},
]
food_total = sum(o['amount'] for o in orders)

tip_total = (food_total * Decimal('0.20'))
delivery_fee = Decimal('11')
shared_extra = tip_total + delivery_fee
n_people = Decimal(len(orders) + 1)  # include Lindsey
per_person_shared = (shared_extra / n_people).quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)

print('food_total', food_total)
print('tip_total', tip_total)
print('delivery_fee', delivery_fee)
print('shared_extra', shared_extra)
print('n_people', n_people)
print('per_person_shared', per_person_shared)

request_payloads=[]
for o in orders:
    total = (o['amount'] + per_person_shared).quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
    request_payloads.append({
        'receiver_email': o['from_email'],
        'amount': float(total),
        'description': 'For Lunch Meeting'
    })

print('request_payloads:')
for rp in request_payloads:
    print(rp)

len(request_payloads)

from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP

# Reuse previously computed token and request_payloads

        user_email=rp['receiver_email'],

    )
    created.append({

        'receiver_email': rp['receiver_email'],

        'description': rp['description'],
        'raw': res
    })
    print('created:', res)

print('total_created', len(created))
print('created_ids', [c['payment_request_id'] for c in created])

from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP

# Expected from earlier computation
expected = {
    'as_moore@gmail.com': {'food': Decimal('19'), 'total': (Decimal('19') + Decimal('5.63')).quantize(Decimal('0.01'))},
    'corwils@gmail.com': {'food': Decimal('28'), 'total': (Decimal('28') + Decimal('5.63')).quantize(Decimal('0.01'))},
    'cheweber@gmail.com': {'food': Decimal('19'), 'total': (Decimal('19') + Decimal('5.63')).quantize(Decimal('0.01'))},

    'ta.weav@gmail.com': {'food': Decimal('22'), 'total': (Decimal('22') + Decimal('5.63')).quantize(Decimal('0.01'))},
    'alexwhite@gmail.com': {'food': Decimal('25'), 'total': (Decimal('25') + Decimal('5.63')).quantize(Decimal('0.01'))},
}

expected_emails=set(expected.keys())

# Fetch all sent payment requests matching description via query
query='For Lunch Meeting'
page_index=0
page_limit=20
all_pr=[]
while True:
    page=apis.venmo.show_sent_payment_requests(access_token=venmo_token, query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    all_pr.extend(page)

print('total_sent_payment_requests_matching_query', len(all_pr))

# Filter to those receivers we expect
matched=[pr for pr in all_pr if pr.get('receiver',{}).get('email','').lower() in {e.lower() for e in expected_emails}]

# Show matched details

for pr in matched_sorted:

# Compare amounts
amount_mismatches=[]
for pr in matched:
    email=pr['receiver']['email'].lower()
    expected_amount=float(expected[email]['total'])
    if float(pr['amount'])!=expected_amount:
        amount_mismatches.append((email, pr['amount'], expected_amount, pr.get('payment_request_id')))

print('amount_mismatches', len(amount_mismatches))
if amount_mismatches:
    for m in amount_mismatches:
        print(m)

# Check uniqueness by receiver email
receiver_emails=[pr['receiver']['email'].lower() for pr in matched]
print('unique_receiver_count', len(set(receiver_emails)))

# Determine success criteria
success = (len(matched)==len(expected) and len(amount_mismatches)==0)
print('verification_success', success)
